meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 给项目添加 Teams 频道：复制并注册 Teams 适配器、安装固定依赖并测试，再登录 Microsoft 创建机器人并写入 .env；完成后应用可从频道、群聊和私信收发消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求为项目添加 Microsoft Teams 渠道或创建 Teams 机器人时触发。

say.text: 给项目加上 Microsoft Teams 渠道。
say.note: 自动执行复制适配器、安装依赖和测试。

say.text: 创建 Teams 机器人并把 NanoClaw 接入。
say.note: 需提供隧道 URL 和机器人名称。

say.text: 把 Teams 集成到应用，机器人叫小助手。
say.note: 若 .env 已有凭据则跳过创建。

howto.what_en: Adds Teams as a channel: it copies the Teams adapter, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, builds and tests, then signs into Microsoft to create a bot and writes credentials to .env, allowing the app to exchange messages in channels, group chats, and DMs.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to add Microsoft Teams channel integration for the project or set up a Teams bot.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams support to this project.
say_en.note: It copies the adapter, installs dependencies, and runs tests.

say_en.text: Create a Teams bot and connect NanoClaw.
say_en.note: You'll need to provide the public tunnel URL and pick a name.

say_en.text: Integrate Teams into the app with bot name 'assistant'.
say_en.note: Skips creation if credentials already exist in .env.
